methodologyNotes: Roster covers twelve electronic pet/cat doors spanning battery microchip flaps (SureFlap), app-connected microchip flaps (SureFlap Connect line), collar-key and microchip electronic doors (PetSafe), ultrasonic-collar automatic doors (High Tech Pet Power Pet), timer/ID-disc and microchip flaps (Cat Mate), and one RFID-collar door-mount unit (PlexiDor), verified 2026-08-05 primarily against manufacturer product pages (surepetcare.com, petsafe.com, hitecpet.com, closerpets.com as the current authorized Cat Mate/Pet Mate US retailer) and cross-checked against Chewy/Home Depot/Amazon listings where those retailers' pages were reachable; several major retailer domains (Chewy, Amazon, Walmart, Petco, plexidors.com) returned bot-blocking (403/429/500) responses to automated fetches during this session, so retailer corroboration is inconsistent across entries and priceUsd is left null with an explanatory priceNote rather than guessed wherever no accessible page displayed a confirmed US price. Three adversarial corrections were made to the seed list: (1) "PetSafe Passport Program" does not exist as a current PetSafe product or program name in PetSafe's live catalog (confirmed absent from both /shop/cat/doors/ and /shop/dog/doors/ listings) — replaced with PetSafe's actual current microchip-activated flap, the "Microchip Cat Door" (PPA19-16145). (2) "Endura Flap Automatic" was dropped: Endura Flap's full current catalog (enduraflap.com/collections/all) consists entirely of magnetic-seal, manually-latched flap doors (wall mount, door mount, sliding-glass panel, sash-window insert) with no RFID/microchip/collar-key activated "automatic" electronic model in the current lineup, so no real product matched the seed name — not substituted, simply excluded rather than fabricated. (3) "PetSafe Wall Entry Kit" was dropped: the only PetSafe product matching that name ("Pet Door for Wall", ZPA00-16201) is a manual push-flap door with a mechanical slide-in closing panel, not an electronic/microchip-activated door, and no separate electronic-specific wall-entry-kit SKU could be found in PetSafe's live catalog. "Ownpets Electronic" was also dropped after checking ownpets.com and retailer listings: Ownpets' current pet-door lineup (confirmed via ownpets.com and Amazon/Walmart listings) consists of magnetic self-closing screen doors, not a microchip- or RFID-activated electronic door, so no genuine matching product exists to research. accessedAt 2026-08-05 throughout.
